blurb: Daytona Ice Arena offers public ice skating sessions, learn to skate programs for all ages, youth hockey camps and clinics led by professional players, figure skating lessons, and group event spaces for corporate and school groups. They provide equipment rentals and have certified coaches for lessons. The facility supports youth travel hockey programs and hosts special camps for skill development.
